quest.title: Reunite, My Shroom Buddies!
quest.description: A friend has left a message at the Adventurers' Guild, inviting you and Paimon to visit her new shop in Bayda Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, a Fungus just floated past. Should it be doing that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Normally, it's pretty dangerous to have Fungi wandering around the city, right? Unless we're talking about the special cases, the super well-behaved ones that have undergone training...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it... Why does this feel so familiar? Haven't we been through something similar before?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! It's Bongo-Head! The Fungi friend we met back in Sumeru!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woahhh! It's been so, so long since we last saw it! Come on, let's go say hi!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks that's... Bongo-Head? The Fungi friend we met back in Sumeru!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woahhh! It's been so, so long since we last saw it! Come on, let's go say hi!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Looks like the message was delivered without a hitch.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: We meet again, Golden Comet, Silver Companion. It's been a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: You're both so radiant and full of life. It feels as though no time has passed at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's really you, Haniyyah and Bongo-Head!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No wonder that message felt so familiar... Guess that means the bond between Paimon and Bongo-Head is still as strong as ever!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I imagined many different ways we might reunite. A grand feast, or a creative welcome ceremony, something that would give you guys a huge surprise.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: But in the end, they all felt a little too formal. You've been busy, and I was worried that taking up too much of your time might cause you trouble.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Besides, our Fungi friends prefer a calm and peaceful environment these days. So, let's keep it simple and reunite in a manner that is both relaxed and easygoing.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: That's right! The prose that Haniyyah's been reading really paid off. A calm state of mind does wonders for our lives, after all!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: At the end of the day, carefree chitchat like this is the greatest joy of all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Souka's here too! There's also Kindlejoy, and... Who's this?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: This is my very own Fungi friend, Stormstress! You and Bongo-Head knocked us out back in the round of 32.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehehe, you remember it so well...

choices.text: It's all starting to come back to me now...

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Anyway, as you can see, dear big shots, we no longer need the chains of dates or places for our next meeting...

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Haniyyah and I have purchased this commercial district and transformed it into the Lil' Fungi Playground!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so you're saying these facilities here aren't rented for the new tabletop game, but...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: You've got it. From now on, we'll be living in Bayda Harbor and promoting the Fungus-themed tabletop game, as well as sharing our theories on communicating with animals.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Feel free to drop by and play with the Fungi friends whenever you have time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh my goodness! This is easily one of the best things Paimon's heard all day!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After the first Fungi Tournament, Paimon thought of sooo many ideas for playing together with Bongo-Head. Now we can finally make them all happen!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Speaking of which, it must be pretty expensive to run this place, right?

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Don't worry, Mora isn't an issue for us right now!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Recently, aside from raising funds by operating tabletop games like Fungus Mechanicus and Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta with Mr. Balfour's help...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: We've also consolidated our past experiences and organized our knowledge about beast taming and Fungi into a more systematic theory, and tried printing a few books.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: In fact, some researchers were interested enough to offer me financial support.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: By using the knowledge I've accumulated to help make things more accessible for others, I earn Mora. In turn, this Mora helps my Fungi friends live better lives. Everything has fallen into a positive cycle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you're amazing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It really feels like Haniyyah has become a calm, dependable... "Beast Taming Theory Expert" who can handle just about anything!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: It's all thanks to Souka's guidance. She encouraged me to follow the students' lead and challenge myself to master the skills I needed to learn.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Hey, hey! I didn't teach you that kind of humility, I'm not a perfect teacher either! If someone compliments you, just accept it!

choices.text: You make it sound easy, but there must've been hard times too, right?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: There were plenty of challenges, yes. But we should let the past and all its hardships fade with the passage of time.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: My biggest regret is that, over the past year, I didn't really take our Fungi friends out to have fun.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Ever since I started consolidating my own theories on beast taming, most of our days were spent in caves and treehouses, writing nonstop as day and night blurred together.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The business side of things is exhausting, and the days spent racing against deadlines were truly hard to get through. I understand Souka's perspective a lot better now.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Well, it's not all negative feedback! There's still that sense of satisfaction when you finish a piece of work!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Yes, I agree. Every finished draft deserves a truly indulgent meal for celebration.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Unfortunately, our Fungi friends can't enjoy our food. From their perspective, perhaps, life might be getting boring.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: If this goes on for too long, their spirits will suffer, and that's not good at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, now that things on your end have settled down and you've got a place to stay...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How about the two of us take the Fungi out for some fun? We can let them play for as long as they want, then bring them back afterwards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That way, you can focus on your work, and the Fungi still get to enjoy themselves!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Count me in!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: When it comes to sightseeing, I'm purely a theory type — I can only look things up in books. When I first came to Fontaine, I even managed to get myself lost...

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Haniyyah's even more of a dummy. She doesn't even know what fun places there are in Sumeru. She's completely absorbed in work!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: We stayed in Fontaine for so long last time, but the itinerary we planned was terrible. In the end, I didn't even manage to visit the dessert shop I had my eye on, and missed out on the macarons I'd been curious about for so long...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Ahem... but if it were Golden Comet and Silver Companion, I'm sure you'd find all kinds of wonderful places. Places that would really impress our Fungi friends and let them have the time of their lives.

choices.text: Then I really need to put some thought into choosing the right spots!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Just a moment, please take this little Kamera with you...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Haniyyah takes out an unassuming Kamera and gently places it on Bongo-Head's head. To everyone's surprise, Bongo-Head balances it with ease, as if already used to flying while carrying things like this...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: It may look ordinary, but it's actually a very special souvenir...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Bongo-Head once saved a merchant's child who had gotten lost in the southern part of the Apam Woods. Out of gratitude, the merchant gave Bongo-Head many gifts, including this Kamera.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Bongo-Head really loves the images it captures. So, you can also use it on this trip to preserve these memories.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I found an equipment specialist, Miss Helene, who sealed the Kamera's casing so it can work in the damp environments Bongo-Head loves... It can even work underwater.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Which is to say... This Kamera is also one of Bongo-Head's badges of honor!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #As for taking photos, don't you worry! {NICKNAME} and Paimon are seasoned pros! The appearance of our gear doesn't matter, what matters is getting great shots!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's get ready and be on our way!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't forget the special food for our Fungi friends...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: That's right! Paimon remembers that part loud and clear. Make sure to bring plenty of Marvelous Jelly.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The latest improved version tastes even better and stores well, too. No matter how hot the environment gets, there's no need to worry about it going bad.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Just be careful not to give our friends too much at once. Overindulging isn't good for them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, got it! Jelly goes into the backpack...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now all that's left is for us to head out — and come back with lots of souvenirs from our trip!

choices.text: I'll pick places that are fun and beautiful!
I want to take the Fungi friends out to play too!
Feels like you glossed over the tough parts...
We can see each other all the time now!
The warm, welcoming atmosphere is helping me relax...
Though I can't quite remember... Hello to you both!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It really is Haniyyah and Bongo-Head! We met at the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. They're longtime friends of ours!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon remembers that we saw them near Port Ormos and in the Court of Fontaine afterwards, too. It's been so long already...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The journey was so long, but Paimon really thinks Teticpac Peak here in Scions of the Canopy territory has so much character. For our Fungi friends, this must be completely new!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon brought a few landscape paintings. We can let the Fungi compare the paintings with what they see right in front of them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They can take a close look, match the scenes up, and then start noticing all the little details they'd normally overlook... If that sparks their interest, then it means this place is perfect for a deeper, longer exploration!

choices.text: That's one way to do it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, when Paimon's got some free time, she reads guidebooks too, studying different sightseeing spots.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's a must-have skill for any good guide!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, shall we let our Fungi friends try for themselves!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, someone left a message at the Adventurers' Guild asking us to visit a new shop in Bayda Harbor... A new shop in Bayda Harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who could it be? Paimon's got a feeling something good's waiting for us... Let's go take a look!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's got a few great places in mind. They'll be brand-new experiences for our Fungi friends!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a bit far, but long trips have their own charm... Why don't we start with Natlan?
